sentences.en: They both walked out of their offices, carrying bulging briefcases.
sentences.zh: 他们两个都提着鼓囊囊的公文包走出了办公室。

sentences.en: Bill is really fighting the battle of the bulge.
sentences.zh: 比尔正在与腹部赘肉作斗争。

sentences.en: I noticed the bulge that appeared between his legs.
sentences.zh: 我注意到他腿间出现了凸起。
